title: Spanish Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish originating from the Valencia region, paella is a savory rice-based meal often made with seafood and meat.
instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until translucent.
Add the artichokes and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the paella seasoning and stir for 1 minute.
Add the Spanish saffron rice and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot, topped with cheese if desired.
